description_en: Retrieves the list of projects in an EMR Workflow workspace
description_zh: 获取EMR Workflow工作空间下的项目列表
name: ListProjects

parameters.help_en:
The pagination cursor.

If this is the first query, leave this parameter empty.

If this is not the first query, set this parameter to the nextToken value returned by the previous call
parameters.help_zh:
分页游标。

如果是首次查询，该参数不传。

如果是非首次查询，该参数传上次调用时返回的nextToken
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The search value, used for regex matching against project names and descriptions
parameters.help_zh: 搜索值，用于项目名称和描述的正则匹配
parameters.name: search_val

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries per page.

When paginating, this value determines the number of entries returned per page. Keep this value consistent across subsequent pages. If not specified, the default value is 100
parameters.help_zh:
分页大小。

分页时，返回参数里返回数量。后续页数的获取，保持和初始页一致，不传默认100
parameters.name: max_results
